selection_rationale: Use the Barnes et al. homologous-expansion relation R_ej=v_ej t with the fiducial v_ej=0.2c at the 1-day reference epoch; this gives 5.18041367424e12 m. The value is a derived spherical-domain proxy, not a directly resolved radius measurement.
Select the 0.2c fiducial within the reported 0.1-0.3c characteristic range for neutron-star-merger r-process ejecta; convert with c=299792458 m s^-1.

Use the abundance-weighted epoch t approximately 2.3 s at which beta-delayed fission becomes the primary fission channel in the neutron-star-merger r-process calculation. This is an explicit literature kinetic proxy, not an isotope-specific half-life.

Use the reported combined Th+U actinide fraction 0.003 for the Ye approximately 0.15 model and normalize it by the 5e-3 solar-mass, 0.2c spherical ejecta fiducial at one day. The resulting 5.12186785866739e-14 kg m^-3 is explicitly a uniform-density source proxy.

Declared surrogate closure for unresolved line-energy transport; units are m^2 s^-1 and the value is not presented as a literature measurement. With delta_r=5e10 m and delta_t=100 s, D delta_t/delta_r^2=0.04, below the explicit 1-D diffusion stability limit.
Dirichlet free-escape surrogate: set the actinide-line source-density proxy to zero at the outer boundary. This is a boundary closure assumption, not a measured density.
Integrate to 10 days (864000 s), covering the 0.1-10 day kilonova evolution window reported in the thermalization literature while retaining the early 2.3 s fission transition.
Explicit-Euler numerical control chosen with the diffusion stability margin D delta_t/delta_r^2=0.04 and 8640 total steps, below the authorized 20000-step budget.
Finite-difference radial spacing of 5e10 m gives about 104 cells across the 1-day domain radius and supports the stated explicit diffusion stability margin. It is a numerical-resolution assumption.
